info.title: Dad's Verses API
info.description:
Poems, the author's highlighted words, likes, comments, and literary analysis.

Reads are open. The poet's own actions need `Authorization: Bearer <AUTHOR_TOKEN>`.

setupAvailable.description: Whether AUTHOR_TOKEN is set, so an account could be created.

post.summary: Create the author account, or reset its PIN
post.description: Gated by the master AUTHOR_TOKEN. On a public site this is what stops the first stranger who finds the page from claiming it. A reset revokes every existing session.

device.description: A label for the session, e.g. "iPad".

reset.description: Required when an account already exists.

401.description: Wrong PIN. The body carries attemptsRemaining.

409.description: No account has been set up yet.

429.description: Locked out. The body and the Retry-After header carry the wait.

token.description: Bearer token for subsequent author requests.
